content.text:
## Summary

Audited the actual code before changing it: `src/index.ts` already used `spawn`/`execFile` with array args everywhere (no `shell: true`, no template-string command concatenation), and the macOS `Contents/MacOS/Godot` nesting in the fixed auto-detect guesses was already at the correct depth. So the literal bugs described weren't present — I refactored the real gaps in the same subprocess-invocation mechanism instead:

**`src/utils.ts`** — new pure, testable helpers: `expandHomePath`/`resolveUserPath` (`~` expansion + `path.resolve`, home dir injectable for testing), `buildWindowsGodotCandidates` (adds `.exe` fallback), `buildMacGodotCandidates` (drills a `.app` bundle into `Contents/MacOS/<name>`, falls back to `Contents/MacOS/Godot`, then the bare path), `LINUX_GODOT_BINARY_NAMES` (`godot4`, `godot`, `Godot_v4` in that order), and `buildGodotOperationArgs` — the exact argv array handed to Godot, extracted so it's unit-testable without spawning anything.

**`src/index.ts`** — `detectGodotPath`/`setGodotPath`/the constructor now route every candidate path through platform-specific expansion before validating. Linux tries `godot4` → `godot` → `Godot_v4` in priority order.
